description: STAGE-CONSISTENCY BASELINE for saga #811 (issue #816 item 5): the `check()` half of a pair whose `-execute` sibling is a CHARACTERIZATION fixture. This half is ALREADY CORRECT today and is expected to survive the fix UNCHANGED — it is precisely the answer the run path never consults, which is the whole of saga #811's shape-A mechanism. Fault shape A — an UNRESOLVABLE NAME in argument position. `check()` computes the right answer (`ol-unknown-command`, whose usual stage is `semantic` per spec/error-model.md:97) and `execute()` never consults it, so the statement is discarded whole with no diagnostic and no effect. Form under test: `every <unresolvable> [ … ]` — the interval handler is never registered. Its shape-B twin — the same form with a KNOWN command in the same position — is `every-interval-check` under `command-in-value-position/`, and asserts the opposite: an empty diagnostics list.
